overview.purpose: Reproducible AKS lab for learning GPU-backed model serving and agent infrastructure.

components.agentgateway: Intended CPU application-pool proxy; implementation paused.
components.llama.cpp: GPU-backed model router with persisted GGUF cache.
components.lab-info: Read-only curated information and bounded router health observation.

limitations: This is versioned configuration, not live deployment discovery.
Gateway integration and this MCP server's cluster deployment are not established.
Spot GPU capacity can be evicted; router health does not establish per-model readiness.
Trusted lab only: no application authentication, TLS, or network isolation is provided.

models.description: General instruction model; Llama community license applies.
